name: Rob Sand
desc: American lawyer and politician and Governor-elect of Iowa (born 1982)
summary:
Robert Howard Sand (born August 12, 1982) is an American lawyer and politician who is the governor-elect of Iowa. A member of the Democratic Party, he has served as the 33rd state auditor of Iowa since 2019.
Raised in Decorah, Iowa, Sand graduated from Brown University and the University of Iowa College of Law.
